enchantments.tooltip: Deception: This weapon is hard to focus upon and thus provides a +3 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, Deception weapons have a small chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Insightful Deception +5: +5 Insight bonus to hit and +8 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Deadly +10: +10 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Shadow Spike: On Damage: Do an additional 2 to 12 Negative Energy damage.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
